headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for Hayward ProLogic/AquaPlus pool controllers. Talks to the panel through the Python sidecar service (AquaConnect HTTP box by default, or an RS-485 serial bridge). See sidecar/install.sh.
footerDisplay: See the [README](https://github.com/homebridge-fun/homebridge-prologic) for wiring and setup instructions.

sidecarHost.title: Sidecar Host
sidecarHost.description: Host where the Python sidecar service is running (usually localhost on the same Pi).

sidecarPort.title: Sidecar Port
sidecarPort.description: Port for the Python sidecar REST API.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (ms)
pollInterval.description: How often to poll the sidecar for state updates.

backend.title: Sidecar Backend

oneOf.title: RS-485 Smart Bridge (pad Pi, direct serial)

backend.description: Which navigation backend the sidecar should use. Changing this restarts the sidecar to apply. 'RS-485 Smart Bridge' is the recommended direct-serial path: a small daemon on a pad-mounted Pi owns the serial link (100% reliable keypresses), reached over Tailscale. 'AquaConnect' drives the HTTP web box (fallback).

aquaconnectHost.title: AquaConnect Host
aquaconnectHost.description: IP of the AquaConnect web box (used when backend = aquaconnect).

rs485bridgeHost.title: RS-485 Smart Bridge Host
rs485bridgeHost.description: Tailnet IP (or resolvable host) of the pad-Pi smart bridge daemon (used when backend = rs485bridge). Prefer the Tailscale IP, e.g. 100.x.y.z — the MagicDNS name may not resolve on the hop.

rs485bridgePort.title: RS-485 Smart Bridge Port
rs485bridgePort.description: HTTP port of the pad-Pi smart bridge daemon (used when backend = rs485bridge).

circuits.title: Circuit switches to expose
circuits.description: Which circuits to expose as HomeKit switches. AUX_2 and VALVE_3 are hidden by default (unused on this system).

activeBodies.title: Active pool bodies
activeBodies.description: Which bodies your panel is configured for. Controls the POOL/SPA mode-selection cycle and which heater setpoints are active. This system: pool + spa only (no spillover).

enableActiveHeaterThermostat.title: Heat Thermostat (mode-following, recommended)
enableActiveHeaterThermostat.description: Expose the single mode-following thermostat that mirrors whichever heater setpoint is active for the current valve mode (name shows 'Heat — Pool' or 'Heat — Spa'). One physical heater = one tile.

enableTemperatureSensors.title: Temperature Sensors
enableTemperatureSensors.description: Expose read-only air and pool temperature sensors.

enableChlorinatorFan.title: Chlorinator Fan
enableChlorinatorFan.description: Expose pool chlorinator output % as a Fan accessory (speed ring = output %). Read/write via Settings menu navigation.

enableSaltSensor.title: Salt Level Sensor
enableSaltSensor.description: Expose salt level (PPM) as an Air Quality sensor tile.

circuitLabels.title: Circuit Label Overrides
circuitLabels.description: Custom display names for circuit switches in HomeKit. Leave a field blank to use the default name.
